tasks.label: Install Databricks AI Gateway Models Extension
tasks.command: tmp=$(mktemp --suffix=.vsix) && curl -fsSL 'https://github.com/alexzubiaga/vscode-databricks-ai-gateway/releases/latest/download/databricks-aigw-models.vsix' -o "$tmp" && code --install-extension "$tmp"; result=$?; rm -f "$tmp"; exit $result
